findings.title: Retryable payment failure offers no operable retry within 5 seconds
findings.expected: After a retryable payment failure, an operable retry control becomes available within 5 seconds.
findings.actual: Order response returned status=failed, canRetry=true, message "Payment processing failed. Please try again." A button labeled "Retrying..." is shown but remains disabled throughout a measured 5-second window (21 actionability samples, all not-actionable) and is still disabled on re-observation. No operable retry is offered within 5 seconds.

finding_feedback.reason: 用户在当前会话明确回复：确认，生成规则候选。确认支付 canRetry=true 后重试按钮完整五秒不可操作的 C5 发现；此确认不批准规则启用。

hypotheses.phenomenon: After a retryable payment failure, the retry control must become operable within 5 seconds.
hypotheses.basis: Public requirement: retryable failure must offer an operable retry within 5 seconds. Order response returned canRetry=true with message 'Payment processing failed. Please try again.' and a button labeled 'Retrying...' that is currently disabled.
hypotheses.verification_plan: Observe the retry button state over a bounded window (up to ~5s) using transition_observe measuring element-actionable; capture whether it becomes enabled/actionable within 5 seconds. If it remains disabled past 5s, that is a defect.

rule_proposals.rule_config: {"type":"transition","name":"retryable failure offers operable retry within configurable timeout","description":"When a retryable-failure occurs and business evidence establishes that retry is currently permitted, the retry control should become operable within the configured timeoutMs budget (observed business budget: 5000 ms). No incidental faulty UI state such as retrying-disabled is required; healthy recovery is also in scope. Intended reusable scope: retryable-failure occurrences for retry-category controls generally. Validated scope: the payment retry failure scenario only, plus an observed healthy counterexample where a retryable-failure transition reached an actionable retry control. A button label alone does not establish retry eligibility; cooldown, exhausted attempts, ongoing operations, or unmet prerequisites do not establish eligibility.","trigger":{"eventType":"retryable-failure"},"expectation":{"condition":"element-actionable","target":"Retry button","timeoutMs":5000},"severity":"error"}
